experiences.description: The Operations Manager helps to provide overall leadership to non-exempt airport employees. This includes responsibility for overall operating performance, customer satisfaction, positing employee culture, safety, and service, budget, and vendor relations. The Operations Manager oversees fleet availability and revenue generation.

Communicated clear expectations and goals from corporate/management to each team member.
Resolved all customer complaints in a professional manner while prioritizing customer satisfaction.
Worked with the management team to implement the proper division of responsibilities.
Oversaw the performance of more than five Sales Representatives.
Ranked consistently in the top two of the department in sales since being hired.
Ability to quickly establish rapport with customers, up-sell products and build a loyal clientele.
Achieved/surpassed sales goals while providing excellent customer service.
